sn45.177:1.1: Pañcimāni bhikkhave nivaraṇāni || katamānipañca || || Kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ vyāpādanīvaraṇaṃ thīnamiddhanīvaraṇam addhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ || imāni kho bhikkhave pañca nīvaraṇāni || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ nīvaraṇānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya || la || ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || || 2--33.
